text: When it comes to gardening, we often forget the importance of watering and pruning our plants. Watering is crucial for keeping soil moist and healthy, while pruning helps to remove dead or damaged branches. However, it's important not to forget to prune your plants too. Pruning helps to keep the plant healthy and prevent disease. In addition to pruning, you should also ensure that your plants are well-stocked with nutrients. This can be done by fertilizing your plants regularly with a balanced fertilizer.
